glosses: …, is that right? (checking what you heard)
patterns.usage_note: Throws back what the speaker has just heard and asks the hearer to confirm it, on a rising tone: on a noun (校庭だって？), and in speech on a plain-form verb with or without ん (行くだって？, 行くんだって？), an attachment this corpus rule does not license. Three siblings share the string: the same form on a falling tone reports the news (臨時休業だって), 'even' on a bare noun (子供だって), and 'even if' on a ta-stem verb (呼んだって).

examples.ruby: 明日[あした]の練習[れんしゅう]、体育館[たいいくかん]じゃなくて校庭[こうてい]だって？
examples.english: Tomorrow's practice is out on the field, not in the gym — that right?

examples.ruby: 隣[となり]の田中[たなか]さん、春[はる]には引[ひ]っ越[こ]しだって？
examples.english: The Tanakas next door are moving out in the spring, is that right?

examples.ruby: え、あの二人[ふたり]、来月[らいげつ]には離婚[りこん]だって？
examples.english: Wait, you're telling me those two are getting divorced next month?
